title: Chou
description: Chou is a decoration mod for me and my friends maybe you can find something useful to you
body:
This is a decoration mod that adds blocks to decorate builds that me and my friends wanted
![overview of the blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5c1f3b373ffd71160791a6cc52165900ba0ae956.png)
- flowers
- flower pots
- lanterns
- sword
- ropes
- ladder
- decorative cardboard box
